% Classic: one-column serif, generous spacing. The safe default template.
%
% ATS-safe by construction: no tables for layout, no multi-column text flow,
% standard \section headings, plain selectable text throughout, and URLs
% printed as themselves (see \resMetaLine and the CONTACT line) rather than
% hidden behind link text. Every package below is confirmed present on a
% plain MiKTeX install with no auto-install prompt.
%
% Placeholders (filled by resume/render.js, never edited by hand):
%   NAME, HEADLINE, CONTACT, BODY - see resume/render.js for the fill() step
\documentclass[10.5pt]{article}

% cmap before fontenc: keeps "fi"/"fl" ligatures copy-pasting and
% ATS-parsing back out as themselves instead of vanishing from the text.
\usepackage{cmap}
\usepackage[margin=0.75in]{geometry}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{charter}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}

\pagestyle{empty}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\raggedbottom
\raggedright

\titleformat{\section}{\large\bfseries}{}{0pt}{}[{\vspace{-6pt}\hrule\vspace{6pt}}]
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{10pt}{2pt}

\newenvironment{resItems}{%
  \begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.15em, topsep=2pt, itemsep=1pt, parsep=0pt]
}{%
  \end{itemize}
}

% Structural macros. Only these definitions differ between templates: the
% content generated by resume/sections.js calls the same macro names no
% matter which template renders it.
% A break belongs before content that exists, never after content that may
% not. "{\normalsize #2}\\" with an empty #2 is the "There's no line here to
% end" error that every profile without a headline used to compile to. The
% test is e-TeX's \detokenize, so an argument that starts with a control
% sequence (an escaped & from a company name) is still read as non-empty.
\newcommand{\resHeaderLine}[3]{\if\relax\detokenize{#3}\relax\else\\[#1]{#2 #3}\fi}
\newcommand{\resHeader}[3]{%
  \begin{center}
    {\LARGE\bfseries #1}%
    \resHeaderLine{3pt}{\normalsize}{#2}%
    \resHeaderLine{3pt}{\small}{#3}%
  \end{center}
}
\newcommand{\resSection}[1]{\section*{#1}}
\newcommand{\resEntryHeader}[3]{%
  \noindent\textbf{#1}\hfill\textbf{#3}\\
  \noindent\textit{#2}\par
}
\newcommand{\resEntryHeaderPlain}[2]{%
  \noindent\textbf{#1}\hfill\textbf{#2}\par
}
\newcommand{\resMetaLine}[1]{{\small #1}\par}
\newcommand{\resEntrySpace}{\vspace{6pt}}
\newcommand{\resSkillRow}[2]{\noindent\textbf{#1:}\ #2\par\vspace{2pt}}

\begin{document}

\resHeader{Jane Doe}{Backend Engineer}{Pune | jane@example.com | \href{https://github.com/janedoe}{https://github.com/janedoe}}

\resSection{Experience}
\resEntryHeader{Engineer}{Acme}{2022 - Present}
\begin{resItems}
  \item Shipped 100\% \textbackslash{}newcommand\{\textbackslash{}x\}\{pwned\} of the roadmap
\end{resItems}
\resMetaLine{Stack: node}

\resSection{Skills}
\resSkillRow{Languages}{JavaScript}

\end{document}
